# M3-02 independent full-contract review and final v74 gate

This directory preserves the preprobe audit wave and final local evidence. The directory name records the v73 review wave; production closed at **episode.v74 / 1015 complete independent inputs / 31 of42 locally accepted V1 tasks**. It is evidence, not a second architecture or plan. Authoritative status lives in `docs/development-plan.md`; semantics live in `docs/architecture.md`.

Only `../../reviewed-full.json` is the admitted full golden corpus. Every row retains its fixed MIT source, independent title assertion, original numbering and seven quality claims, exact expected result, confidence and rationale. Duplicate input bytes count once. The1758 raw-input pool, synthetic controls, generated snapshots, incomplete original assertions, and unqualified/contradictory source claims grant no authority.

Frozen evidence includes `rls-frozen266.json`, `chill-frozen33.json`, `hellberg-frozen85.json`, `small-scout-frozen41.json`, `next-A-frozen63.jsonl`, `next-B-frozen62.json`, and `viren-frozen35.json`. They retain both admitted and unresolved original expectations. A failed frozen contract is not converted into gold by matching the production output. `rls-contract-conflicts.json`, `rls-source-exclusions.json` and `next-A-unresolved.json` preserve the source conflicts and exclusions. `cehbz-history.json`, `cehbz-literal-history-evidence.json`, `cehbz-provenance-report.md` and the five `cehbz-history-*.go.source` originals establish handwritten independent assertions;17 completed records were admitted, while22 synthetic controls remain excluded. The old capacity and pending inventories explicitly remain historical snapshots.

Final production changes preserve lexical facts and original bytes while refusing partial coverage from ranges, unbound numbering, collections, subtitles, ZIP and explicitly named split-RAR files. Year, movie ID, another numbering token or slash suffix cannot revive refused coverage. Bare dimensions never prove progressive resolution. Conflicting quality claims remain unknown. Existing canonical IDs, current-mapping requirements, account checks and physical task protections remain enforced. Passing the sample threshold does not authorize automatic TV or packages.

Actual final evidence:

- `v74-media-quality-race.log`: `go test -race ./internal/domain/media ./internal/domain/quality -count=1 -timeout=600s`, both packages passed;1015 full golden contracts and both public API refusal controls are included.
- `v74-native-pg-receipt.jsonl`: private PostgreSQL18.6, `PULSE_RECOVERY_RUNTIME=1`, actual three-path `TestAppRunReviewedEpisodeFullPipeline`, `TestAppRunOriginalEpisodeRecoveryAfterRestart`, seven acquisition receipt/invalidation guards, numbering publication/replay, identification-correction HTTP history/recovery and stale-cache checks. Six selected root tests passed, zero selected skips/failures. Database/temp cleanup receipts are present.
- `mapping-history-pg.jsonl`: PostgreSQL race for `TestFileMappingHistoryAtomicRecoveryAndEvidence`, including lock order and persisted historical facts. Its stale fixture now seeds a real active administrator; production permission checks were preserved.
- `v74-lint.log`, `generated-drift.log`, `dependency-guards.log`: zero lint findings, generated-code drift check and dependency allow/deny probes passed.
- `final-receipt.json`: final admitted count, corpus digest, gate commands and source-census resolution.

Reproduction requires the toolchain from `.mise.toml`, a private PostgreSQL harness and an explicit database; never fall back to a shared database. Required PG entries are `TestAppRunReviewedEpisodeFullPipeline`, `TestAppRunOriginalEpisodeRecoveryAfterRestart`, `TestReviewedEpisodeAcquisitionAtomicReplay`, `TestEpisodeMappingHTTPPublicationReplayAndCurrentVersion`, `TestFileMappingHTTPHistoryAndRecovery`, `TestCandidateExplanationCacheNeverAuthorizesStaleAvailability`, and `TestFileMappingHistoryAtomicRecoveryAndEvidence` under their respective packages. Set `PULSE_RECOVERY_RUNTIME=1` for the original-plan restart probe.

M3-03 is next: complete independent coverage/UoW, package versus single-episode contention and submission-time expansion revalidation. Its pure completeness predicate alone grants no download authorization. Hosted CI, real NAS/external integration and subsequent automatic TV/package/upgrade/cross-device gates are separate acceptance work.
